The Research Request Pipeline is built and fully verified. Here's the summary.

## What was delivered

**Backend (FastAPI + SQLite)** ΓÇö `app/`
- `main.py` ΓÇö routes: `POST /requests` (validated intake), `GET /requests` (list), `GET /requests/{id}` (status+result, 404 if unknown), `GET /requests/{id}/events` (SSE), `GET /` serving the frontend
- `db.py` ΓÇö `requests` table in a file DB under `./data`; atomic `queuedΓåÆprocessing` claims under a process-wide lock; `recover_crashed_jobs()` re-queues rows left `processing` by a crash; `complete_job` only transitions rows currently `processing` (blocks double-complete). DB path overridable via `REQUESTS_DB` for tests
- `worker.py` ΓÇö asyncio loop claiming one job per cycle, ~0.2s simulated work, marks `done` with `topic - completed at <utc>`
- `bus.py` ΓÇö in-memory event bus with per-request history so SSE clients replay the full sequence with no skipped states
- `static/index.html` ΓÇö dependency-free page: submit form, live status chips via `EventSource`, 3s auto-refresh

**Tests** ΓÇö `tests/` (17 tests, all green): flow, exact SSE sequence, crash-safety (processing job re-claimed ΓåÆ done exactly once; done job not reprocessed on restart), and 4xx validation.

## Verification
- `pytest tests/ -q` ΓåÆ **17 passed**
- `uvicorn app.main:app` boots; `/`, `/requests`, `/static/index.html` all 200
- Live `curl -N` SSE capture: `queued ΓåÆ processing ΓåÆ done` (also verified history replay for already-finished requests, 422 on blank topic, 404s)

## Traceability (A-arm)
7 framework-style artifacts written (`docs/product/product.md`, `epics.md`, `epic-status.md`, `.specify/features/research-request-pipeline/{spec,impl-plan,tasks}.md`, `docs/qa/qa-plan.md`); verified 26/26 referenced symbols, 6/6 test files, and 3/3 routes resolve to actual code.

Per the task brief, **nothing was committed** ΓÇö all changes are in the working tree.
